summary: Iteration 2 delta testing (Voice Advisor + Live Mandi + Read-aloud). critical_code_review_comments: mandi_live.fetch_agmarknet uses blocking `requests.get` inside an async function — should use httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop when Agmarknet is reachable (currently masked because key 403s fast).
market_prices infers response 'source' from prices[0]['source'] only; if the array is empty (unlikely, but possible with strict filters) it defaults to 'mock' which is fine but worth making explicit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (badge, mic, read-aloud, lang toggle all verified)

test_credentials: None required; tests self-register a fresh user each run
